# proxmox_guest_pending (Data Source)

Reads pending guest configuration changes as JSON from `GET /nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/pending`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_pending" "qemu" {
  type = "qemu"
  node = "pve"
  vmid = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pending` (String)
